package.name: turtlebot_bringup
package.description:
TurtleBot AMR bringup and launch coordination.
This package orchestrates all robot subsystems: - Robot description (URDF) - Hardware interface / Simulation - Localization (EKF) - SLAM / Map-based localization - Navigation (Nav2)
LEARNING OBJECTIVES (builds on learning_execution): - Understand complex launch file composition - See TimerAction for startup sequencing - Learn conditional launching patterns - Practice mode switching (sim vs hardware, SLAM vs nav)
